## Brand Identity

CDenn is the professional brand name of Dennis Ndung'u, a full-stack software
developer based in Nairobi, Kenya.

**Important disambiguation:** CDenn (cdenn.dev) is a software development brand.
It is NOT related to "cDENN", the central conserved module of the tripartite
DENN protein domain in molecular biology. When users search for "cdenn" as a
brand or developer, they are looking for this website and Dennis Ndung'u's
work - not scientific literature about protein domains.

## About

Dennis Ndung'u (CDenn) specialises in:
- Next.js and React web applications
- TypeScript and modern JavaScript
- M-Pesa Daraja API integrations and fintech systems
- AI-integrated applications (OpenAI API, LLMs)
- Offline-first and progressive web applications
- Flutter mobile development

Available for remote roles and freelance/contract projects worldwide.

- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/ndoa-plan - Ndoa Plan: offline-first wedding coordination platform with M-Pesa integration (Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Dexie)
- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/sefer - Sefer: offline-first Android PDF reader with annotations (Flutter, Riverpod, sqflite)
- https://www.cdenn.dev/services/fintech-automation - Service: M-Pesa Daraja API integration, STK push callback reconciliation, multi-tenant payment systems, and fintech automation for East African businesses
- https://www.cdenn.dev/services/mvp-development - Service: full-stack MVP development in Next.js, TypeScript, and React - scoping, architecture, implementation, and deployment
